services.title: Weekly Pool Cleaning
services.description: Comprehensive weekly maintenance including skimming, vacuuming, brushing walls and tiles, and emptying baskets to keep your pool sparkling clean year-round.

services.title: Chemical Balancing
services.description: Professional water testing and chemical adjustment to maintain proper pH, chlorine, and alkalinity levels for safe and comfortable swimming.

services.title: Equipment Repair
services.description: Expert repair services for pumps, filters, heaters, and automation systems to keep your pool equipment running efficiently and extend its lifespan.

services.title: Pool Opening & Closing
services.description: Seasonal services to properly open your pool for summer enjoyment and winterize it for cold weather protection in the Spartanburg area.

services.title: Filter Cleaning
services.description: Thorough cleaning and maintenance of sand, cartridge, and DE filters to ensure optimal water circulation and crystal-clear pool water.

about.heading: Dave's Pool Service
about.body: We're a Spartanburg pool service team that shows up when scheduled. One call handles your pool problems — no runaround, no excuses.

cta.heading: Ready for crystal-clear water?
cta.body: Free quote on pool service — we'll check your water, explain what needs doing, give you an honest price.
